# Tactile paper recipe

Concept: a talk told on printed paper, animated like stop-motion. Maroon textured ground, newsprint and archive pages, near-black grotesque titles, white brush arrows, one crimson marker. Each noun becomes a physical sheet: it unfurls from a corner, curls in from an edge, or turns like a page. Designed motion steps on twos (12 fps); the payoff steps on threes (8 fps). A paper scene turns away to uncover the speaker's face on the personal lines. Captions are black condensed pills of one to three words that swap hard. The film ends flat on the face.

## Working rules
- Paper is a body. Sheets enter, leave and change only through a fold: unfurl from the bottom-right corner, curl in from the right edge, turn away. No fades, no flat slides. Every sheet has paper texture and a contact shadow. Paper on camera never holds still.
- Two clocks. Designed moves hold each drawing 1/12 s (twos), or 1/8 s (threes) on the payoff. Footage, caption swaps and reveal timing stay on the 30 fps clock. Stepping reads as handmade.
- The hook is half a sentence plus an object. Frame 0 already moves (a page unfurling). Title words rise whole, on twos. A zoom-blur push lands on the next stressed word. Title and arrow vanish on the jump frame.
- The speaker is the page beneath. A paper scene gives way to the face by turning the whole frame away. Face time is 45-60% of the film, each paper scene 3.5 s or less. Never draw on the face; a sheet may sit below it.
- Hand marks only direct the eye. White arrow (black on the flat ground): look here. Crimson underline: printed words the speaker paraphrases. Crimson ellipse: the single thing they name. Marks belong to their paper and leave with it.
- The payoff is a bookend. The hook object returns on threes with one new object, then turns away on threes onto the face. No outro card.

Rule out:
- a collage of cut-outs flying about (paper moves from its corners and edges)
- smooth vector animation (no eased tweens on paper)
- a vintage filter on the person
- live 3D (draw the fold in 2D)

## Footage and captions
Footage: take the user's talking head from `list_media`, as one `<video>` (`assets/media/upl_<id>.mp4`) at the bottom of the stack, `object-fit: cover`, untouched (no grade, no texture). Horizontal source: reframe to vertical (craft `reframe.md`). Paper scenes are full-frame layers above the video, so a page turn exposes the face. The example paints a stand-in (warm room, an SVG person who bobs, blinks, talks); swap `#ruang` and `#plate` for the real video. A sheet under the face starts at y >= 1215 in vertical, or sits in the side column in 16:9.

Captions: build pills from the `inspect_media` transcript `words {text,start,end}`.
- 1-3 words, 17 characters max.
- Swap hard on the first word of each chunk.
- Hide the pill while a title or rising word on screen shows the same text.
- Confirm names and years with the user.

## Surfaces
Ground: `--latar`, lighter in the centre (radial 70 x 55% at 45% 60%) and falling off toward the top-right like a cast shadow. Add a fibre-noise image painted once, overlay 35%. The flat twin for before/after scenes is plain `--latar-2`, no texture.

Sheets: newsprint (`--koran`) or letter paper (`--surat`), with a mottle image painted once (multiply 35%) and a contact shadow (drop-shadow 0 10 16 at 42%). A resting page occupies x 35-1048, top edge near y 610, bleeding off the bottom. A close-up scales it 1.12x, tilts it -2 degrees, and leaves a strip of ground above. Typeset pages so they look real: spaced small-caps masthead over a rule, serif headline, justified serif body.

The fold, rebuilt in 2D: a fold line at about 4.5 degrees sweeps across the sheet. Everything beyond it is cut off with `clip-path: polygon`, and a back-of-page flap (`--balik`, darker toward the fold) lies over the front. The corner unfurl slices off the bottom-right corner diagonally and exposes the triangle's back while the page scales down from 1.42 and rotates from 9.9 degrees to rest.

Prints: halftone photos (dots on an 8 px grid, painted once) on a white border, curling in from the right edge. Tickets: mono type on letter paper.

Gobo: a soft half-plane shadow (48%, 40 px feather, about 140 degrees) over close-ups, creeping slowly.

Zoom blur: two faint copies of the page at 1.06x and 1.12x, their opacity following the blur curve. The scale jump hides inside. No CSS blur on a full frame.

## Colour tokens
- `--latar`: maroon ground; `--latar-2`: its flat twin. `--teks`: near-black titles and the rising word. A dark brand turns these light, which is right.
- `--utama`: fill of the plain-fact label box (a name, a year), lettered with `--teks-di-utama`. Charcoal in the base look, or the brand colour.
- Fixed for every brand: `--koran` newsprint, `--surat` letter paper, `--balik` page back, `--cetak` print ink, `--spidol` crimson marker (underlines, ellipses), `--panah` white arrow, `--panah-gelap` black arrow, `--pil` pill at 85% with `--pil-teks`. Footage colours never change.
- Reference: ground `#522333`, `#60293C`, `#240F16`; flat ground `#6A2947`; marker `#990028` on newsprint `#B7B9B7`.

## Type
`--font-judul`:
- Hook title: weight 800, 128 px, tracking -2.56 px, sentence case, flush left at x 96, 132 px line pitch, in the upper quarter.
- Rising word: 190 px, centred just above a page edge.
- Label box: 58 px.
- Inter 800 stands in for a near-black neo-grotesque; Archivo Black or Oswald 700 also work.

`--font-isi` (pill captions): 800, 62 px, uppercase, squeezed to 0.8 with `scaleX`, 88 px tall, 22 px padding, 12 px radius, centred at y 1400 (16:9: y 890).

Faces on printed objects (fixed): Libre Baskerville for body (37 px, line-height 1.6, justified); Playfair Display 700 for headlines (60 px); IBM Plex Mono 600 for tickets and forms; Caveat 700 for handwriting, only the speaker's own words. No em dashes on paper. Paper carries only the speaker's words or plain fact.

## Step timing
Every designed move is a run of held drawings: 12 fps for the hook, close-ups, entrances, labels; 8 fps for the payoff. Use `steps()` or a stepped proxy. Never ease paper smoothly.

- Unfurl, 12 drawings on twos: scale 1.42 to 1.00, rotation 9.9 to 0 degrees, offset (248, 426) to 0 px, corner cut 414 to 0 px, fastest at the start (1.29 by drawing three). On the hook, begin at drawing three so frame 0 is already moving.
- Title rise: each word appears whole and opaque, 12-57 px low, and rises to rest in 4 drawings on twos; words start one drawing apart.
- Arrow, one value per drawing. Shaft length 0.30 / 0.64 / 0.85 / 0.98 / 1 / 1; head 0 / 0 / 0 / 0.3 / 0.8 / 1. Black arrow: 0.45 / 0.75 / 0.93 / 1, head last.
- Zoom-blur push: blur 5 / 15 / 17 / 12 / 9 / 6 / 3 / 0 px across 13 frames starting at the word. The 1.217x jump lands 2 frames in, then +0.24% per step.
- Holds: always moving. Close-ups push +0.1% each twos step; the gobo creeps across.
- Marks: underline starts at 80% of its ink on the first drawing, then 93%, then 100%. Ellipse draws in 4 drawings on threes, head last.
- Edge curl: 5 drawings (x 620 to 0, rotation 22 to -7 degrees, width 0.35 to 1), ending tilted -6 to -8 degrees.
- Label box: pops on its word, then boils at 8 fps (+-1.2 degrees, +-1.5 px).
- Rising word: letters start 230 / 100 / 40 / 12 / 1 / 0 px under rest, one letter per drawing, emerging from behind the page's top edge.
- Page turns:
  - whole-frame fast turn, 5 drawings on twos: 0.08, 0.20, 0.42, 0.63, 0.90
  - payoff turn, 3 drawings on threes: 0.10, 0.55, 0.85
  - slow in-scene turn, 13 drawings on twos, linear
- Exits are hard. Titles and arrows vanish on the push's jump frame, marks leave with their page, nothing fades.

## Camera
- Zoom-blur push, 1.217x on the stressed word: into the object, "this one". Hook object, a named source.
- Slow stepped push (+0.1-0.24% per step): the page is alive, keep reading. Every paper hold.
- Page close-up, 1.12x, -2 degrees, gobo: reading closely, evidence. A quote, a price, a printed fact.
- Whole-frame page turn onto the face: from the record to the person. Personal lines, after a paper scene.
- Slow in-scene page turn: the other side of the idea. Before/after, then/now.
- Hard cut: default between paper and face, and for everything else.

## Signature moves
- Half a line and the object. The title writes the sentence's first half while the page that completes it unfurls from the corner; a white arrow links them; the push lands on the next stressed word. For: "Ada satu koran di rak Bapak"; a shop's first receipt; a teacher's old exam paper; the letter that starts a story.
- Source under the face. Face as shot, the cited page unfurls beneath it, a charcoal label pops on the name or year. For: "Pasar Lama, 1952"; a supplier's catalogue; a study's journal page; a family certificate.
- Read closely. Page close-up, gobo drifting, crimson underline beneath the paraphrased words, a print curling in on its noun. For: market stalls; a product's first batch; a classroom photo; the street where a story happens.
- The other side. On the flat ground a page turns slowly onto a blank one; the idea's single word rises letter by letter from behind its edge, a black arrow pointing down. For: "Hilang"; "Baru"; "Lunas"; "Kosong".
- Bookend with a price. The hook page returns on threes, a ticket or bill lands on it, price circled in crimson, then the full frame turns on threes onto the face for the closing line. For: "5 sen"; a course fee; a show ticket; what the story cost the hero.

## Pitfalls
- Smooth motion on paper reads as vector animation. Step every designed move.
- Fades and flat slides on sheets or type break the illusion. Use a fold, a curl or a hard cut.
- Paper never covers the face: a sheet in a face scene stays below the chin or in a side column.
- Paper scenes over 3.5 s, or too many of them, starve the face (it needs 45-60%).
- Printed sources carry their real text, handwriting is the speaker's own line, labels are plain fact. Nothing the speaker did not say. No em dashes.
- Keep the pill at y 1400 on 1080 x 1920. Never below y 1500, where the platform UI sits.
- No live 3D, no CSS blur: the fold is 2D clip-paths with a shaded flap; the zoom blur is two faint copies.
- Performance: paint textures once as images; stepped updates rewrite only a few transforms and clip-paths; the page clones used for blur are static.

## Reference numbers
- Unfurl scale 1.418 to 1 and rotation 9.92 to 0 degrees over 24 reference frames; corner fold offset 414 to 7 px.
- Zoom blur 5 / 15 / 17 / 12 / 9 / 6 / 3 / 0 px over 13 frames with a 1.217x jump.
- Rising letters 100 / 40 / 12 / 1 / 0 px.
- Turn curves: FAST (0.08, 0.20, 0.42, 0.63, 0.90); EIGHT (0.10, 0.55, 0.85).
- Gobo darkening 0.44-0.52 at about 320 degrees.
- Captions 62 px, scale 0.8, y 1400.
- Face on screen 45-60%, paper scenes 3.5 s or less, 2.5-3.5 sounds per 10 s in the source.

# Tactile paper: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.0, medium 2.8, long 3.4.

## hook

- en: the title writes half the line on maroon ground, the object finishing it unfurls from a corner on frame 0, white arrow, zoom-blur push
- id: judul menulis separuh kalimat di tanah marun, benda penutupnya membuka dari sudut di frame 0, panah putih, dorongan zoom-blur

## problem

- en: a print of the trouble curls in over a page close-up on its noun, a crimson ellipse round the one thing named, the gobo drifting
- id: cetakan foto masalahnya melengkung masuk di atas halaman dekat pada kata bendanya, elips merah tua mengitari satu hal yang disebut

## fact

- en: the face as shot, a printed source unfurls below it, a charcoal label with the name and year sticks on and boils at 8 fps
- id: wajah apa adanya, sumber cetak membuka di bawahnya, label arang berisi nama dan tahun menempel dan bergetar 8 fps

## step

- en: one paper scene per step: a card or ticket lands on its word on twos, a white arrow steers to it; a page turn to the next
- id: satu adegan kertas per langkah: kartu atau karcis mendarat pada katanya dua-dua, panah putih mengarahkannya; balik halaman ke berikutnya

## compare

- en: on the flat ground the page turns slowly onto its other side; the idea's word rises letter by letter from behind the edge
- id: di tanah datar halaman berbalik pelan ke sisi lainnya; kata idenya naik huruf demi huruf dari balik tepi halaman

## number

- en: the figure printed on a ticket or ledger curls in, circled in crimson on its word; the pill caption says the unit
- id: angka tercetak di karcis atau buku catatan melengkung masuk, dilingkari merah tua pada katanya; caption pil menyebut satuannya

## proof

- en: page close-up 1.12x tilted -2°, gobo drifting, crimson underline under the printed words paraphrased, a print curls in
- id: halaman dekat 1,12× miring −2°, bayangan jendela bergeser, garis merah tua di bawah kata tercetak yang diucapkan, cetakan foto masuk

## offer

- en: a price ticket slides onto the page on twos, its price circled in crimson, a white arrow to it; caption pill names it
- id: karcis harga meluncur ke halaman dua-dua, harganya dilingkari merah tua, panah putih ke sana; caption pil menyebut namanya

## cta

- en: the hook page returns on 8 fps with a card of the contact, then turns away on threes onto the face, held 2 s
- id: halaman pembuka kembali 8 fps dengan kartu kontak, lalu berbalik tiga-tiga ke wajah, diam 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: the hook object returns on 8 fps with one new object naming the cost, turns away on threes; ends flat on the face, 2 s
- id: benda pembuka kembali 8 fps dengan satu benda baru yang menyebut harganya, berbalik tiga-tiga; berakhir datar di wajah, 2 dtk
